issues.summary: 【Test Environment】【Folax】【V5.4.2】【X6870】【India】【English】【Function】【RT】【Must】【Intelligently summarize and read aloud】 “Summarize current page content” shows placeholder response “*{Reply}” instead of generating summary
issues.description:
h3. Description

When the user clicks “Summarize current page content” under “Intelligently summarize and read aloud”, the feature does not work correctly.

Instead of summarizing the current page, a popup displays placeholder/debug text {{*\{Reply}}} along with the message:
 “Please provide the text you would like me to summarize.”
h3. *Frequency:*
Reproducible: 3/3
h3. Preconditions
 # Folax app is installed and launched successfully
 # Device is connected to internet
 # App language is set to English

h3. Action Steps
 # Open Folax app
 # Set app language to English
 # Navigate to Explore page
 # Tap on “Intelligently summarize and read aloud”
 # Click “Summarize current page content”
 # Observe the response popup

h3. Actual Result
 * Bottom popup shows placeholder text {{*\{Reply}}}
 * Message displayed: “Please provide the text you would like me to summarize.”
 * Current page content is not summarized

h3. !image-2026-05-15-14-51-02-404.png!
h3. Expected Result
 # Clicking “Summarize current page content” should directly generate and display the summary
 # No placeholder/debug text should be visible to the user

*Video link*: [https://transsioner.feishu.cn/file/UtDnbKWFVoqnbgxIRWZcNCLFn8e?from=from_copylink] 

*Log link:* [https://transsioner.feishu.cn/file/GPNFbMFxuo9kiexKdYVcCqgNnEh?from=from_copylink]

issues.description:
h4. *A) Preconditions* 

  !image-2026-01-13-17-09-59-416.png!

*B) Steps to reproduce:*
 # Receive a 1-page document in a WhatsApp message and check the TTS result
 # Receive a 2-page document in a WhatsApp message and check the TTS result
 # Receive a 11-page document in a WhatsApp message and check the TTS result
 # Receive a 25-page document in a WhatsApp message and check the TTS result

 

*C) Actual results:*

WhatsApp broadcaster does not change the number and word of "страниц" depending on the case

 
||Number of pages||Current TTS||Expected TTS||
|1|...файл один страниц...|...файл одна страница...|
|2|...файл два страниц...|...файл две страницы...|
|11|...файл одиннадцать страни...|...файл одиннадцать страниц...|
|25|...файл двадцать пять страни...|...файл двадцать пять страниц...|

 

D) *Expected result:*

Different cases usage depending on the number of document's pages.

 
||Number of pages||How the word "*страница*" changes||How the word "*страница*" changes||
|If the number ends with 1:
 1,21,31,41...
  
 *EXCEPT: 11*|*Nominative case*
 страница|*Nominative case*
 одна, двадцать одна, тридцать одна, сорок одна...|
|If the number ends with 2-4:
 2,3,4,22,23,24,32,33,34...  
  
 *EXEPT: 12,13,14*|*Singular genitive case*
 страницы|*Singular genitive case*
 две, три, четыре, двадцать две, двадцать три, двадцать четыре, тридцать две, тридцать три, тридцать четыре...|
|*11,12,13,14*|*The genitive case of the plural*
 страниц|*The genitive case of the plural
 *одиннадцать, двенадцать, тринадцать, четырнадцать...|
|If the number ends with 0 or 5-9:
 5,6,7,8,9,15,16,17....|*The genitive case of the plural*
 страниц|*The genitive case of the plural
 *пять, шесть, семь, восемь, девять, пятнадцать, шестнадцать, семнадцать...|

*E) Log + Video + Documents used:*
